_comment: Hand-curated inputs for the Claire Hughes Johnson feed. 'watch_feeds' are scanned item-by-item every run, which catches episodes the iTunes episode index misses. 'search_terms' drive broad discovery of shows she has never been on before. Add to either list freely.
_exclude_comment: Substring-matched against the show name. These are book-summary and review shows: they put the author's name in the episode title, so every episode about Scaling People looks like an appearance even though she is never on them.
